reference.name: real_line2
reference.description: existing_lines_full[1] of the full Xi'an city, scored in the line1_only city

notes: Real Line 2 is scored in the line1_only city (chained reward, 27 stations).
Centroid weight (1/3,1/3,1/3) is not on the H=4 lattice; the centroid line is the deployable lattice line minimising g(f|centroid) over the record's policy front.
Vertex and centroid use deployable modes only (best_of_32 and greedy_top8_starts are excluded).
Percentiles use the null of all lines (dead ends kept); the *_full_length_null variant excludes dead ends.
Percentile of MSD, Hausdorff and orientation: lower values are better.
